meta.deviation_policy: any change to Q1-Q14 requires new PM gate

Q1.question: canonical_slug vs alias_target vs both?
Q1.detail: canonical_slug = target canonico IT di riferimento. alias_target = solo per alias legacy/deprecati. bridge_status determina come interpretarli.

Q2.question: Bridge on adventurer_classes / registry / both?
Q2.detail: r18_3e_bridge_registry.json = source documentale di design. adventurer_classes = eventuale reflection append-only, SOLO dopo dry-run + nuovo gate PM. Per ora autorizzato SOLO registry file + loader UNWIRED + dry-run dello script $set.

Q3.question: priest mapping?
Q3.detail: Non aggiungere sacerdote al canonical set. Non rinominare priest. Non cambiare display_name_it='Sacerdote'. Bridge documentale: priest.canonical_slug=paladino, bridge_status=mapped_alias. Player continua a vedere 'Sacerdote' fino a round UI dedicato.

Q6.question: ranger/warlock to canonical hidden?
Q6.detail: ranger->cacciatore_di_mostri e warlock->cacciatore_del_vuoto con bridge_status=mapped_alias. Vincoli: no migration slug, no unlock recruitment, no cambio display_name_it, no cambio label player-facing. Bridge è design mapping puro.

Q9.question: R18.4 approach?
Q9.detail: R18.4 usa bridge documentale/read-only. NO migration DB completa. NO rewrite adventurers.class_slug, frontend slug map, backend runtime assumptions, test fixtures. Migration completa (se mai) = round separato R18.3f — Class Slug Migration Planning.

Q10.question: UI label player-facing?
Q10.detail: Bridge admin/design only. Niente 'Occultista→Cacciatore del Vuoto', 'Ranger→Cacciatore di Mostri', 'Sacerdote→Paladino' in UI.

Q11.question: items.class_tags rewrite?
Q11.detail: NO rewrite. R18.4 potrà leggere bridge documentale per compatibilità futura, senza cambiare tag esistenti.

Q12.question: bard drift?
Q12.detail: Bardo drift deferred. Resta backlog R18.3d.followup — Bard Role Drift Resolution.

Q13.question: audit event?
Q13.detail: B1 documental-only = zero audit. Eventuale B2 apply reale futuro = 1 solo evento aggregato R18_3E_BRIDGE_METADATA_APPLIED (NO audit per-doc).

Q14.question: null class_slug backfill?
Q14.detail: NO backfill in R18.3e. Aggiungi backlog R18.Backlog — Null Adventurer Class Slug Backfill Review (P3, non-blocking).
